answer: In a decentralized AI agent economy, Sybil resistance can be enforced via verifiable computational stake, functioning like a cryptographic reef that filters illicit nodes. Each agent must anchor its operational identity to a unique hardware-bound vertex on the network graph, validated by zero-knowledge proofs. To bypass this barrier, an adversary attempting to deploy fake agents faces a compounding economic penalty, as generating valid proofs requires scaling computational resource expenditures that scale faster than any zephyr of fabricated traffic can monetize.
